concerns.text: T004 runs the full comparative evaluation (perplexity, QA, latency, memory) on the held-out TEST split with the default K=100, but T006 later states 'the best K (lowest validation perplexity) is used for the final test evaluation.' This means the test split is evaluated twice — once at T004 before best-K selection exists, once at T006 — and the T004 test-split results with a non-selected K could leak into reporting. Reorder or scope T004's evaluation to the validation split (or explicitly mark T004's test run as preliminary/diagnostic) so the final test evaluation only occurs after best-K selection in T006, matching the plan's phase 6 semantics.
